title: Rethinking Oscar's architecture: extensibility, modularity, and a path forward
author: joeyjurjens
body_preview: This builds on discussions from #2972 (2019) about splitting Oscar into core/storefront/dashboard and extracting business logic from views. Those ideas were never fully realized. This issue goes further and proposes rethinking Oscar's fundamental extensibility model. title: Has anyone upgraded a production app from 2.9 → 2.10 yet? How did it go?
author: ahaselsteiner
body_preview: Hi 👋  In our project using dj-stripe, we’ve upgraded a development branch to `dj-stripe==2.10.3`. The upgrade required a couple of manual fixes on our side, but the branch itself is now stable and technically ready to go to production.
